usageNotes: Use this to modify an existing metrics server entry (InfluxDB, Graphite, or OpenTelemetry) in the cluster-wide metrics configuration; requires Sys.Modify on the root path (/). The 'port' and 'server' fields are always required even on updates — omitting them will fail. Use the 'delete' param (comma-separated field names) to unset optional fields rather than setting them to empty strings.

examples.summary: Switch an existing InfluxDB metrics server from UDP to HTTPS v2 API with token auth

tips: The 'delete' param accepts a comma-separated pve-configid-list — use it to clear fields like 'token' or 'bucket' when switching protocol types.
Pass 'digest' (obtained from the GET endpoint) to guard against concurrent edits overwriting each other.
InfluxDB v2 API requires 'influxdbproto' set to 'http' or 'https' plus 'bucket', 'organization', and 'token'; v1 compatibility uses 'user:password' in the token field.
For Graphite destinations, set 'path' to a dot-notation prefix (e.g. proxmox.mycluster) and optionally set 'proto' to 'tcp' for reliable delivery.
Set 'disable' to true to pause metric shipping without deleting the configuration.
OpenTelemetry params (otel-*) only apply when the server type is OTLP; mixing otel-* params with InfluxDB/Graphite configs has no effect but will not error.
